# PR #3084: Patch: one press of End turn or a one-tap answer sends once, so a double click can't end an extra turn

Closes #3060

## What changed

`Game.tsx`'s `dispatch` now drops an `endTurn`, `answer` or `mulligan` that equals the last one it sent against the same `view` object. A double-clicked End turn, a double-tapped one-tap choice and a double-pressed mulligan Ready each send once. After an extra-turn card, the second End turn no longer ends the extra turn unseen.

- **Release on a new view.** A new `view` is a new object, so the guard needs no clearing, and a click after a new view sends.
- **Release on an error.** An `error` that gains text (a refusal or an offline send) clears the guard, in a `useLayoutEffect` so the release is in place before the next click.
- **What stays unguarded.** The set is `ONCE_PER_VIEW`. Concede, plays, attacks, activations, market buys, trades and the draw offer's moves are never dropped. The click and drag paths and the auto-end-turn effect still call `onAction` directly.
- **Hotseat.** It builds a new view object on every render, so it never blocks.
- **Rules.** The change is client-only and enforces no rule, per CLAUDE.md rule 7.

The rest of the diff is ruling **R3060000** (`spec/rulings/R3060000.md`, proven in `Game.test.tsx`), its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/3060.md`, a §10.10 paragraph in `spec/10-engine-guide.md`, and an `apps/web/README.md` paragraph after "Concede asks first". Six `it("R3060000 …")` tests in a new `describe` in `Game.test.tsx`:

1. Two End turn clicks send one `endTurn`. A new view lets the next click through, and a repeat on that view is dropped.
2. A non-empty `error` releases the guard. The error line clearing back to `null` does not.
3. A double-tapped one-tap choice sends one `answer`. A different answer still goes. The same answer on a new view goes again.
4. A double-pressed mulligan Ready sends one `mulligan`.
5. Concede (confirmed twice) and attacks (done twice on one view) are never dropped.

# #3060: Patch: one press of End turn or a one-tap answer sends once, so a double click can't end an extra turn
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Online and in practice, the board waits a moment for the game's answer after you press End turn. Until that answer arrives the button still works, so a double click sends End turn twice. Usually the second one is refused, and a red "it is not your turn" line sits on the board for the whole of the opponent's turn. But when the card you played gave you an extra turn, the second End turn is accepted and ends the extra turn before you have seen it. A double tap on a one-tap choice does the same thing. Once this is built, a repeat of the same End turn or answer against the same board is dropped.

## Why

- `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx:541`: `const legal = shown === view ? offered : NOTHING_LEGAL;` keeps the shown view's moves live until a new view arrives, and `dispatch` (:545-551) sends every call.
- `apps/web/src/game/Board.tsx:666-675`: `pressEndTurn` sets `pressedFor` and calls `onControl("end-turn")`, but never checks `pressed` (:605) first. The button only "stays visibly depressed" (:520).
- `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx:1255-1259`: an immediate pick calls `send([key])` with no check that it was already sent.
- `apps/web/src/game/net.ts:847`: every send gets a fresh nonce, so the engine's nonce dedupe never sees the repeat.
- Extra turns are taken when the turn ends (`crates/engine/src/state.rs:1391`, `extra_turns`, R846). The player is still the active one, so the second End turn is legal. Event Horizon (`stinkyscape/c004_3_event_horizon.rs`) and Temporal Rift (`meditative/c019_1_temporal_rift.rs`) grant extra turns.

## Proposal

- In `Game.tsx`'s `dispatch`, remember the last `endTurn`, `answer` or `mulligan` body sent and the `view` object it was sent against, and drop an equal body sent against the same view.
- A new view, or a change of the `error` prop (a refused or offline send), clears that memory so a retry goes through.
- Leave concede, auto end turn, plays, activations and market buys alone: a repeat of those can be intended, and the engine refuses what it must. This only collapses a duplicate intent against one view and enforces no rule (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
- A ruling note for the behaviour, a test named after it, and its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx` and `Game.test.tsx`.
- `apps/web/README.md` (the board's dispatch).
- `spec/rulings/` and `spec/pending/` (§10.10).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Two End turn clicks against one view send one `endTurn`. After a new view, a third click sends.
- [ ] A changed `error` prop releases the guard, so End turn sends again after a refusal or after going offline.
- [ ] A double-tapped one-tap choice sends one `answer`, and a double-pressed mulligan Ready sends one `mulligan`.
- [ ] Concede and plays are never dropped.
- [ ] Hotseat, whose views arrive at once, behaves as it does today.

## Size and risks

Small: about 40 lines in one module, plus tests and a ruling note. The risk is an accepted action that brings no new view, which would block an identical retry. Releasing the guard on any error and on any new view covers refusals and offline sends.
